Proposition
[Bernoulli expansion] \group lobachevsky Source: thurston:page-0174

Let $B_n$ denote the Bernoulli numbers in the standard convention, so that $B_2=1/6$ and $B_4=-1/30$. For $0<|\theta |\leq \pi $, \[ \Lambda (\theta )=\theta \left(1-\log |2\theta |+\sum _{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{(-1)^{n+1}B_{2n}}{2n}\frac{(2\theta )^{2n}}{(2n+1)!}\right). \] The series converges absolutely throughout $|\theta |\leq \pi $, and its right-hand side extends continuously to $0$ with value $\Lambda (0)=0$.
